title: Motif Update Available
description: Natural typing placement above the keyboard matching Google & Apple Notes, and automatic update delivery.
changelog:
• Natural typing positioning: Active line stays right above the keyboard without shooting to the top
• Steady cursor placement: Text stays in-place when tapping or typing in the middle of notes
• Smooth, jump-free typing across all long documents
• Live meeting audio recording controls & lock screen notification
• Table of contents for AI transcripts and notes
